say:9:1421325007:1.text: If you continue to let this go, the village is doomed!

say:11:1421325009:1.text: You're still talking like you possess echorite-quality weapons!

say:17:1421325015:1.text: They're just <style="highlight">children</style>... Children who don't understand or agree with what the adults are doing.

say:20:1421325017:1.text: That's a human stereotype. We dwarves aren't walking math machines. We just have a natural love for minerals, structures, and things that actually matter.
say:20:1421325017:1.source_cn: 真是人类偏见，我们矮人又不是数理机器，我们只是天然喜欢...

say:21:1421325018:1.text: Oh, sure, during the Ironheart Dominion, a handful of people were math whizzes. The rest of us? We just suffered through it like it was some kind of punishment.

say:22:1421325021:1.text: Most of these children are just finishing their basic courses, and suddenly, they're opposing everything under the sun. Every single day, it's something new.
say:22:1421325021:1.source_cn: 总之，这些孩子大部分也就是刚上完基础培训课程的岁数，接...

say:23:1421325022:1.text: When we had friendly relations, they opposed the Empire. When Eldric ran things, they opposed him. Now, they opposed anything that can be opposed.
say:23:1421325022:1.source_cn: 我们与帝国友好的时候他们反对耀光，弗林做事时他们也反对...

say:24:1421325023:1.text: So, what about these blueprints that Eldric left behind? Weapons from the Ironheart Dominion...
say:24:1421325023:1.source_cn: 那么，弗林留下的这所谓宝贝图纸又是什么？帝国时期的武器？

say:25:1421325024:1.text: It's an ancient blueprint obtained during a dragon egg ritual. It's written in old dwarven runes. We were only able to partially decipher it and determine that it was some kind of weapon.
say:25:1421325024:1.source_cn: 是发掘龙蛋时得到的古老图纸，用矮人符文记录，我们只能部...

say:26:1421325025:1.text: We attempted to reproduce it using the limited information we had, including using echorite. After testing, I confirmed that the final product didn't meet our expectations.

say:27:1421325026:1.text: So we kept it sealed here. You can see everything else is just old documents.
say:27:1421325026:1.source_cn: 所以就一直封存在这里，你们也能看到，其他都是些旧文件。

say:28:1421325027:1.text: In other words, this blueprint and the use of the Ironheart Dominion's name were just another one of Eldric's covers. It has no practical value, and creating a real weapon is impossible.

say:29:1421325028:1.source_cn: 那至少不用担心这帮小孩造出什么大规模杀伤性古代兵器了……
